messages:
ben: Heads-up — running into a weird timeout/ retry interaction in the Kotlin suspend adapter. If a request has a per-call timeout set (call.timeout()) and an auth interceptor triggers a refresh+replay, the suspend path sometimes hangs until the app-level deadline and then fires a duplicate retry. Java callback path preserves the timeout and avoids the dup. Anyone seen this?

alex: Interesting. Which okhttp/retrofit? Can you paste the suspend adapter code?

ben: Retrofit 2.9 + OkHttp 4.11.0. Adapter simplified: `suspend fun Call.await(): Response<T> { enqueue(callback); suspendCoroutine { ... } }` — I think we forget to propagate call.timeout() or the deadline when cloning or replaying. Stack shows long wait then `java.net.SocketTimeoutException: timeout` followed by interceptor replay sending another attempt.

priya: Does the auth interceptor call `chain.proceed(newRequest)` synchronously during refresh? If the adapter suspends the coroutine and the original Call's timeout expires, the coroutine might resume with a timeout and then logic re-triggers a new Call. If the cloned call didn't carry the original timeout, behavior diverges.

lee: We saw this previously with cancellation semantics — coroutine cancellation should cancel the underlying Call (`call.cancel()`) and the interceptor retry should clone & set the same timeout. OkHttp exposes `call.timeout()` which has `timeout()` and `deadlineNanoTime()`. When cloning a Call you need to re-apply a deadline/timeout to the new call's timeout object.

ben: Repro steps: set per-call timeout `call.timeout().timeout(2, TimeUnit.SECONDS)` then trigger auth 401 after ~1s from test proxy. On Kotlin suspend path the request stalls ~2s then coroutine resumes with timeout, then the auth interceptor replays and we get a second attempt, which sometimes completes and causes duplicate side effects. Java callback flow attaches the timeout to each attempt correctly.

alex: Possible fixes: (A) in suspend adapter, when cloning a Call for execution do `val next = original.clone()` and copy timeout/deadline: `next.timeout().timeout(original.timeout().timeoutNanos(), TimeUnit.NANOSECONDS)` — there's no direct getter for nanos so you may need to check `deadlineNanos()`/`hasDeadline()`. (B) make adapters call `call.withTimeout(...)` at coroutine level instead of relying on Call timeout, then ensure cancel propagates to call.cancel().

priya: Also add a debug log in interceptor when it plans to replay due to 401 and include whether the candidate Call has a timeout/deadline set. That will help catch missing propagation in tests.

lee: I'll sketch a test that sets a per-call timeout, uses a fake auth proxy that returns 401 first then 200, and asserts exactly one replay/side-effect. We'll run on emulator API 30/33. Mark it flaky for now until we stabilize.

ben: I pushed a tiny PR that clones and re-applies timeout/deadline on the clone and wires coroutine cancellation to call.cancel(). PR #5123. Unit tests passed but instrumented e2e flaky on emulator: ci-bot flagged timeout.

ci-bot: ci: PR #5123 - unit tests passed :white_check_mark: instrumented e2e failed on API 33 intermittently :hourglass_flowing_sand:.

alex: Nice start. We should also update SDK docs + onboarding sample app to mention per-call timeouts and how they interact with suspend adapter and auth retries. Add a short troubleshooting note: "If you see duplicate side-effects after auth refresh, check per-call timeouts and ensure suspend adapter clones and copies deadlines."

priya: Filed INF-7777 with repro and proposed test matrix. Assign @lee to stabilize tests and @ben to follow-up on docs and a small logging improvement.

ben: Thanks — will update the sampleapp README and add a debug snippet: ```kotlin
// ensure timeout is applied to cloned call
val clone = call.clone()
if (call.timeout().hasDeadline()) clone.timeout().deadline(call.timeout().deadlineNanoTime())
clone.timeout().timeout(call.timeout().timeoutNanos(), TimeUnit.NANOSECONDS)
```

lee: Minor nit: `timeoutNanos()` is internal; use `timeout().timeout()` + `hasDeadline()`/`deadlineNanoTime()` where available. Add guard for API compat.

ben: Good call. Moving to backlog for a small follow-up to stabilize instrumented tests and update docs. Thanks! :thumbsup:
